Hey! Stop! It's still under investigation here!\nDo not enter!! We haven't found out what may\ndamage your health...
What? King Elbano?\nWell, then. But don't needlessly touch things\naround here...
Anyways, I still don't get it...\nMagic wastes reacted with one another\nand exploded? That almost never happens...
Hm? Beyond here? We haven't been there, so we have\nno idea what's in there. Hmm, I can't stop you\nsince it's the King's order. Be very careful!
Nooo! Have mercy on me, please!
...Eh? Oh, don't scare me...\nWhat?\nYes, I'm working at this place...
What happened, you asked? I don't really know\neither...I was working as usual and...\nNo, wait...
Come to think of it, I saw many black things like\ncrystals among the wastes...
But I put them in the incinerator anyway and...\nOh, that's right!\nThere was an explosion after a while!!
Black crystals?! Oh, not again.\nWhat's going on?
Oh! The incinerator is in there! It's dangerous!!\nI hear weird sounds inside after the explosion...
Did I peek inside, you asked? *shudder*\nHow can I get close to such a horrible place?!
